name: exe
description: One install for the way you work with Claude Code: multi-account Jira, GitLab and Figma contexts, a usage-limit guard with Telegram alerts, and a bundle that brings your favourite plugins to every machine.

plugins.name: exe-kit
plugins.description: The bundle. Installing it pulls in exe-contexts, exe-usage, caveman, ast-index and Matt Pocock's skills in one step.

plugins.name: exe-contexts
plugins.description: Jira, GitLab and git identity per organization, chosen automatically from the repo's remote host. Tokens stay in the keychain and are injected per command by shims for jira and glab.

plugins.name: exe-usage
plugins.description: Usage-limit guard: a status line with both rate-limit windows, a burn-rate predictor that runs a Fable analysis while budget remains, deterministic Telegram alerts at the limit, and /why-limits on demand.

plugins.name: exe-figma
plugins.description: Figma through figma-developer-mcp with the personal access token of the current context. Enable it per project; it is not part of the bundle.
